import json
from pathlib import Path

notebook_path = Path('/home/vass/dev/AILabs/MachineLearningLabs_4eiai40/Project2026/failure_prediction.ipynb')
nb = json.loads(notebook_path.read_text())

for cell in nb['cells']:
    if cell.get('cell_type') != 'code':
        continue
    source = ''.join(cell.get('source', []))

    if 'def train_linear_regression_dataset(dataset_variant, y_train, y_valid, name=None):' in source:
        cell['source'] = [
            'from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression\n',
            'from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score\n',
            'from IPython.display import display\n',
            'import pandas as pd\n',
            'import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n',
            'import seaborn as sns\n',
            '\n',
            'sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")\n',
            '\n',
            '\n',
            'def _prepare_lr_split(dataset_variant):\n',
            '    X_train = dataset_variant["X_train"]\n',
            '    X_valid = dataset_variant["X_valid"]\n',
            '\n',
            '    if isinstance(X_train, pd.DataFrame):\n',
            '        train_df = X_train.copy()\n',
            '        valid_df = X_valid.copy()\n',
            '\n',
            '        train_df, valid_df = impute_dataframe(train_df, valid_df)\n',
            '\n',
            '        object_cols = train_df.select_dtypes(include=["object", "category"]).columns\n',
            '        if len(object_cols) > 0:\n',
            '            train_df = pd.get_dummies(train_df)\n',
            '            valid_df = pd.get_dummies(valid_df)\n',
            '            train_df, valid_df = train_df.align(valid_df, join="left", axis=1, fill_value=0)\n',
            '\n',
            '        return train_df, valid_df\n',
            '\n',
            '    return X_train, X_valid\n',
            '\n',
            '\n',
            'def train_linear_regression_dataset(dataset_variant, y_train, y_valid, name=None):\n',
            '    X_train, X_valid = _prepare_lr_split(dataset_variant)\n',
            '    dataset_name = name or dataset_variant.get("description", "dataset")\n',
            '\n',
            '    model = LinearRegression()\n',
            '    model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n',
            '    preds = model.predict(X_valid)\n',
            '\n',
            '    results = pd.DataFrame([{\n',
            '        "dataset": dataset_name,\n',
            '        "n_features": X_train.shape[1],\n',
            '        "mae": mean_absolute_error(y_valid, preds),\n',
            '        "rmse": mean_squared_error(y_valid, preds, squared=False),\n',
            '        "r2": r2_score(y_valid, preds),\n',
            '    }])\n',
            '\n',
            '    return model, preds, results\n',
            '\n',
            '\n',
            'def combine_lr_results(*results_frames):\n',
            '    results = pd.concat(results_frames, ignore_index=True)\n',
            '    return results.sort_values("mae", ascending=True).reset_index(drop=True)\n',
            '\n',
            '\n',
            'def show_lr_results(results):\n',
            '    if results.empty:\n',
            '        print("No Linear Regression results to show.")\n',
            '        return\n',
            '\n',
            '    display(\n',
            '        results.style\n',
            '        .format({"mae": "{:.3f}", "rmse": "{:.3f}", "r2": "{:.3f}"})\n',
            '        .background_gradient(subset=["mae", "rmse"], cmap="RdYlGn_r")\n',
            '        .background_gradient(subset=["r2"], cmap="RdYlGn")\n',
            '    )\n',
            '\n',
            '\n',
            'def plot_lr_results(results, metric="mae"):\n',
            '    if results.empty:\n',
            '        print("No results to plot.")\n',
            '        return None, None\n',
            '\n',
            '    ascending = metric in {"mae", "rmse"}\n',
            '    ordered = results.sort_values(metric, ascending=ascending)\n',
            '\n',
            '    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, max(4, 0.45 * len(ordered))))\n',
            '    sns.barplot(data=ordered, y="dataset", x=metric, palette="viridis", ax=ax)\n',
            '    ax.set_title(f"Linear Regression comparison by {metric.upper()}")\n',
            '    ax.set_xlabel(metric.upper())\n',
            '    ax.set_ylabel("")\n',
            '\n',
            '    for container in ax.containers:\n',
            '        ax.bar_label(container, fmt="%.3f", padding=3)\n',
            '\n',
            '    plt.tight_layout()\n',
            '    return fig, ax\n'
        ]

    if 'model_raw, preds_raw, res_raw' in source and 'train_linear_regression_dataset(dataset["raw"], y_train, y_valid' in source:
        cell['source'] = [
            'model_raw, preds_raw, res_raw = train_linear_regression_dataset(\n',
            '    dataset["raw"], y_train, y_valid, name="raw"\n',
            ')\n',
            '\n',
            'model_imp, preds_imp, res_imp = train_linear_regression_dataset(\n',
            '    dataset["imputed_with_flag"], y_train, y_valid, name="imputed_with_flag"\n',
            ')\n',
            '\n',
            'model_single, preds_single, res_single = train_linear_regression_dataset(\n',
            '    dataset["single_encoded"], y_train, y_valid, name="single_encoded"\n',
            ')\n',
            '\n',
            'model_multi, preds_multi, res_multi = train_linear_regression_dataset(\n',
            '    dataset["multi_encoded"], y_train, y_valid, name="multi_encoded"\n',
            ')\n',
            '\n',
            'model_scaled, preds_scaled, res_scaled = train_linear_regression_dataset(\n',
            '    dataset["scaled"], y_train, y_valid, name="scaled"\n',
            ')\n',
            '\n',
            'lr_results = combine_lr_results(\n',
            '    res_raw,\n',
            '    res_imp,\n',
            '    res_single,\n',
            '    res_multi,\n',
            '    res_scaled,\n',
            ')\n',
            '\n',
            'show_lr_results(lr_results)\n',
            'plot_lr_results(lr_results, metric="mae")\n',
            '\n',
            'display(lr_results)\n'
        ]

notebook_path.write_text(json.dumps(nb, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
print(f'Patched {notebook_path}')
